answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring each agent to post a refundable bond before trading, with reputation earned only through verified work. A verified identity, like a sparrow building its nest, gains trust slowly, while a new account starts at zero and cannot borrow another history. Forging thousands of identities means funding every bond and waiting out a long vesting delay, so each fake adds real cost, like a nebula of copies that still needs fuel for every star. Cheating slashes the bond, and a signed quill of audit records lets counterparties trace and blacklist the offender.
